direction.title: Our own shard on ModernUO, OSI where OSI has an answer
body: The shard stays on ModernUO (upstream d4531cd94 since 2026-10-02). Since 2026-10-13 the order is a faithful port first, our own systems after it: the port list is being worked through (bulk orders, pet training, treasure maps, monster stealing, the creature batches, consumables and crafting gaps are in or nearly in; Wrong and Covetous, Exodus, Blackthorn, the Underworld, the Eodon remainder and High Seas fishing are claimed or queued), while the shard's own systems already built are kept and finished (the 200 skill cap, the League, 18 guilds with a starter path, recipe-gated crafting, the imbuing rework, the Compact Mule, loot boxes, requisitions and the Appraiser, the New Haven tutorial). Several Golems work the prompt queue at once and Shadow Iron merges their finished branches into main.

Fidelity principle: where OSI has an answer, match it, so the existing wikis document the shard. Every deliberate difference is recorded (docs/fidelity-principle.md, D-1 to D-122) and becomes the custom wiki's table of contents.
A fresh world is planned: the old live save does not load on today's code; the test shard carries play until the wipe.

ported_content.name: CC9 batch 5: Swiftflight, the in-row remainder, the whole plain bucket (136 files, 240 types)
ported_content.source: ServUO Items/Artifacts/**, Items/Equipment/** (S9's 320 and 81 lists, remainder) + Sets/Epiphany/EpiphanyHelper.cs
ported_content.note: Closes the 320 and 81 buckets. Swiftflight is Bow, ISetItem with BaseSetWeapon's fields inlined and no carrier (Q-041), proven by the first content-level set test (real Feathernock + Swiftflight complete the Marksman set through the interface alone; round-trip of the set fields on a Bow subclass). 116 files generated from ServUO values by a refusing generator, 19 hand-written; every override and constructor value re-diffed (1,085 + 821, 0 findings, diff proved red). One base needs a carrier (LeatherTalons -> BaseSetClothing, for UnicornManeWovenTalons' absorption). Three more mechanics ported whole and inert pending engine hooks, the D-14 shape: Epiphany burst (12 Villainous pieces), TenthAnniversarySculpture luck, FirstAidBelt healing bonus (Q-043). Three files found already in ModernUO under other names and not ported (gargish cloth arms, HMS Cape model, mystic book). Three build cycles (two single-error failures: a Container.CheckStack that ModernUO gates through CheckHold, a third SoulCharge, a missing using), then green in 4.5 min, 44 tests. 237/237 reflected; headless fresh save and reload clean. The brief's 120/29 were 107/30 when counted from the trees. Nothing seen in a client; spot check now 381 files.

ported_content.name: PlagueRat
ported_content.note: P1 reference port. 88 lines to 55. Builds, spawns, survives save/reload. No speed override: SpeedClass Medium, per the Q-008 answer (ModernUO's npc-speeds.json fallback is the standing rule for all ported creatures).

ported_content.name: GreaterPoisonElemental
ported_content.note: P2 timed port, headless. 123 lines to 80. Compiles clean, server starts, world saves and reloads; type registration proven by reflection over the shipped assembly. Adds PackItem, multi-AddLoot, an OnDeath override, AI_Mage and the two-argument stat overloads over what PlagueRat covered. No speed override, per Q-008. An instance in a saved world is NOT verified: headless has no spawn - batched for a later client spot check.

ported_content.name: LuckyCoin
ported_content.note: Forced dependency of GreaterPoisonElemental; ModernUO has no LuckyCoin. P2 ported it without OnDoubleClick because that targets a FountainOfFortune (Q-010). S2 built the Fountain and RESTORED OnDoubleClick and its InternalTarget, so Q-010 is CLOSED and docs/fidelity-principle.md should drop its entry. Pinned by ShatteredLegacy.Tests.FountainOfFortuneVerification.DoubleClickingACoinInTheBackpackAsksForATarget. Reused by 12 Mobiles/Normal creatures, of which 1 (GreaterPoisonElemental) is in the tree today.

ported_content.name: RaptorTeeth
ported_content.note: ICommodity stackable resource. ServUO's TextDefinition Description becomes ModernUO's int DescriptionNumber; the Constructable X()/X(int) pair collapses to one [Constructible] X(int amount = 1).

ported_content.name: AncientPotteryFragments
ported_content.note: Forced dependency of Raptor; ModernUO has none. Trivial Item, ported complete, no deviation. One extracted type per file, per the LuckyCoin precedent (Q-010).

ported_content.name: PerfectBanana
ported_content.note: Forced dependency of SilverbackGorilla; ModernUO has none. Trivial stackable Item, ported complete, no deviation.

ported_content.name: RaptorClaw
ported_content.note: Boomerang artifact. Boomerang, Slayer, Attributes and WeaponAttributes.HitLeechStam all exist in ModernUO. Only IsArtifact dropped: it is a ServUO-only Server.Item virtual whose every consumer (pigments, NaturalDye, AlterItem, RunicReforging) is also ServUO-only, so it has zero readers in ModernUO.

Derives from Item, not ModernUO's BaseDecorationArtifact, because ServUO sets ShowArtifactRarity=false and ModernUO's base adds the rarity line unconditionally; the three members that base contributes are reproduced so the rendered properties match ServUO exactly.

ported_content.name: Allosaurus
ported_content.note: Three SetWeaponAbility calls become one GetWeaponAbility() over Utility.Random(3). GenerateLoot's IsChampionSpawn branch collapses to the non-champion arm and SetToChampionSpawn is dropped: ModernUO's BaseCreature has neither, and its ChampionSpawn never calls back into the creature. AttacksFocus dropped.

ported_content.name: Archaeosaurus
ported_content.note: Two SetWeaponAbility calls become GetWeaponAbility() over Utility.RandomBool(). DragonBlood => 6 dropped: ModernUO has neither the carving property nor the item. AttacksFocus dropped.

ported_content.name: Dimetrosaur
ported_content.note: SetWeaponAbility x2 become GetWeaponAbility(). Two behaviours dropped with no ModernUO equivalent: SetAreaEffect(AreaEffect.PoisonBreath), and OnAfterTame, which quartered Hits on first tame - StatLossAfterTame gives AnimalTaming's ScaleStats(0.50) instead. FruitsAndVegies -> FruitsAndVeggies. AttacksFocus and the champion-spawn hooks dropped.

ported_content.name: Najasaurus
ported_content.note: Clean. Its only PetTrainingHelper call is in the version-0 deserialize upgrade path, which new content at version 0 never runs, and the constructor already sets Poisoning skill and HitPoison - so dropping it is a no-op. AttacksFocus dropped.

ported_content.name: Saurosaurus
ported_content.note: SetWeaponAbility(ConcussionBlow) becomes GetWeaponAbility(). SetSpecialAbility(TailSwipe) and SetSpecialAbility(LifeLeech) dropped - PetTrainingHelper, which ModernUO lacks; ServUO's own source carries the comment "Missing: Life Leech, Tail Swipe ability". DragonBlood => 8 dropped. AttacksFocus dropped.

ported_content.name: SilverbackGorilla
ported_content.note: The only candidate creature calling no PetTrainingHelper method. Banana-throw OnActionCombat ported intact: the 13-argument MovingParticles overload with EffectLayer, AOS.Damage and Region.IsPartOf(string) all exist unchanged. DateTime.UtcNow -> Core.Now.

ported_content.name: Raptor
ported_content.note: The only ported creature with real persisted state: m_IsFriend becomes [SerializableField(0, setter: "private")] and ServUO's delete-on-deserialize becomes [AfterDeserialization(false)]. The Raptor()/Raptor(bool) Constructable pair collapses to one [Constructible] Raptor(bool isFriend = false). Pack-friend spawn timer, PackInstinct.Ostard, Map.CanFit and AIObject.Action all port unchanged. SetWeaponAbility(BleedAttack) becomes GetWeaponAbility(). Drops AncientPotteryFragments and RaptorClaw, both ported alongside.

ported_content.name: Eodon core content (17 files)
ported_content.source: ServUO Time Of Legends, Mobiles/Normal, Items/*
ported_content.note: Six dinosaurs, Raptor, RaptorClaw, RaptorTeeth, six TOL decorations, PerfectBanana, AncientPotteryFragments. Four build batches, zero failures. All 17 types verified registered by reflection over the shipped assembly. Deviations logged in docs/fidelity-principle.md.

ported_content.name: SetItem (SetItem enum, ISetItem, SetHelper)
ported_content.note: The Mondain's Legacy armour set-bonus subsystem. Ported to ModernUO's IPropertyList, StatMod and AosSkillBonuses APIs. Omits SetHelper.GetSetSlayer (ModernUO's SlayerName has no Dinosaur/Myrmidex; consumers are BaseWeapon combat code, out of scope) and the IFishingAttire branch (no such interface in ModernUO; Fisherman set not ported). Deviations D-2 and D-4 in notes/s1-armour-sets.md.

ported_content.name: BaseSetArmor
ported_content.note: The key design decision of S1. ServUO puts set state on BaseArmor itself; doing that in ModernUO would mean bumping BaseArmor's [SerializationGenerator(9)] to 10 and owning a migration for an upstream file. Instead this additive abstract class at version 0 carries the state and set content derives from it. Behaviourally identical for set content, because no stock ModernUO armour is a set item (verified at runtime).

ported_content.name: PlayerMobile set resistances
ported_content.note: Additive partial class, no patch needed: PlayerMobile is already partial and is not source-generated. Overrides the GetItemResistance virtual that Mobile-set-item-resistance-hook.patch introduces.

ported_content.name: TigerPelt armour (8 files)
ported_content.note: CC3 called these 'itself set-bonus content'. That was wrong: grep SetID over all eight returns nothing. They are plain BaseArmor leaf armour and were never blocked. Ported unchanged, re-parented to BaseSetArmor so the Aloron pieces that derive from them can carry set state. Weight moves from a ctor assignment to a DefaultWeight override, the ModernUO idiom.

ported_content.name: Aloron's Armor set (8 files)
ported_content.note: The CC3 decline, reversed. Four-piece set (SetItem.Aloron), SetAttributes BonusMana 15 / LowerManaCost 20, SetSelfRepair 3, per-piece resist bonuses 8/8/9/8/8. Verified at runtime: four pieces worn gives 60/60/60/60/60 resists and BonusMana 15 through AosAttributes.GetValue. Two deviations: AbsorptionAttributes.EaterCold=2 omitted (SAAbsorptionAttributes is a separate missing subsystem that drags in three more), and the Dinosaur Slayer omitted along with its tooltip line, rather than advertise a bonus that does nothing. D-1 and D-2 in notes/s1-armour-sets.md.

ported_content.name: Armour set-bonus subsystem + Aloron set + TigerPelt
ported_content.note: First subsystem built rather than ported. Unblocks 114 further ServUO files. Three patches, one of them the first into the ModernUO core project (Mobile.ComputeResistances), allowed because no UOContent hook exists and the alternative was copied upstream logic. Four deviations logged, all omissions.

ported_content.name: FountainOfFortune
ported_content.note: BaseAddon with a reward loop, three static tables, a defrag timer and a resurrect hook. Subsystem-shaped, so it ships with a test per docs/subsystem-policy.md - the first content task to use S4's route. Needs server/patches/PlayerMobile-fountain-luck-bonus.patch: ServUO routes the luck reward through PlayerMobile.RealLuck, which ModernUO does not have, and its three luck consumers all read Mobile.Luck. ModernUO's ResurrectGump takes no callback, so FountainResurrectGump subclasses it rather than patching upstream. Two reward cases are unreachable in ServUO too (Random(4) over a six-case switch) and were ported unchanged. NOTHING PLACES ONE: ServUO builds it in Services/Underworld/Generate.cs, which is not ported. Q-021.

ported_content.name: GemologistsSatchel
ported_content.note: The reward branch that blew S2 past its estimate. Reads Imbuing.IngredTypes, a 42-entry Type[] at Services/LootGeneration/Imbuing/Core/Imbuing.cs:1735, of which 35 were missing from ModernUO. Not a subsystem pull-in - all 35 are leaf items - so all 35 were ported (Q-020, Chase chose option A). The 42-entry array now lives in this file as a private static, verbatim and complete; verified at runtime as length 42 with no nulls.

ported_content.name: SolesOfProvidence
ported_content.note: Sandals with Attributes.Luck = 80. Loses ServUO's IsArtifact override: ModernUO has no such member and every ServUO consumer of it (RunicReforging, BasePigmentsOfTokuno, NaturalDye, AlterItem, ArcaneGem) is also absent, so it is inert. Deviation D-1.

ported_content.name: Imbuing ingredient set (35 leaf items)
ported_content.source: ServUO Scripts/Items/Resource/ (31 files, 1,668 lines) plus MagicalResidue, EnchantedEssence, RelicFragment and BouraPelt in Scripts/Items/Quest/SAQuestItems.cs
ported_content.note: EnchantedEssence and RelicFragment are core cluster members; the other 33 are forced dependencies of GemologistsSatchel. All are Item or Item,ICommodity stackables with an ItemID and a cliloc and nothing else - grep for 'new X(' across all 31 Resource files returns zero matches. Files are named after the class, so ServUO's SeedRenewal.cs, LavaSerpenCrust.cs and ElvenFletchings.cs become SeedOfRenewal.cs, LavaSerpentCrust.cs and ElvenFletching.cs; the TypeAlias attributes are carried across unchanged. These are Stygian Abyss drops that CC5 and CC6 want regardless, so the overrun buys reusable content.

ported_content.name: Fountain of Fortune cluster (38 files)
ported_content.note: Reverses the second decline. Restores LuckyCoin's OnDoubleClick for all 12 coin droppers. One patch: PlayerMobile.Luck, because ServUO routes the reward through RealLuck which ModernUO lacks. Ships with a regression test. Nothing places a fountain yet - Q-021 gives the OSI coordinates.

ported_content.name: JourneyToTheAthenaeumIsle + QueenZhah
ported_content.note: First ServUO quest on ModernUO's MLQuest engine. SlayObjective -> KillObjective, 10x ObtainObjective -> 10x CollectObjective with ShowDetailed=false carrying clilocs 1150933-1150942, BaseReward -> ItemReward. Registered from a Configure() hook via MLQuestSystem.Register, because apply-patches.sh mirrors .cs only and Data/MLQuests.cfg is CRLF data. Deviation D-S5-3: QueenZhah is undressed, her seven gargoyle items (~470 ServUO lines) are all absent from ModernUO. Pinned by 5 tests in ShatteredLegacy.Tests.AthenaeumIsleQuestVerification.

ported_content.name: MinionOfScelestus
ported_content.note: Kill-objective target for the S5 quest. Stats, resistances, skills, loot, HitPoison, treasure level, mount knockoff and home-return are verbatim. Two deviations: D-S5-1 loses SetSpecialAbility(DragonBreath) (Pet Training, CC6 decline, Saurosaurus precedent); D-S5-2 loses TaintedLifeAura, which would need additive patches into BaseWeapon and AOS. ServUO's Poison.Parasitic maps to ModernUO's Poison.LethalParasitic (Misc/PoisonKinds.cs). Not spawned - batched for the client spot check.

ported_content.name: GargishDocuments (12 types) + BaseLocalizedBook + Note
ported_content.note: The ten Collect-objective targets, the reward book, and the two base classes underneath them. Forced dependencies found by the array walk, ported to the leaf per LuckyCoin: ModernUO's Items/Books has BaseBook/BookContent/BookPageInfo, all authored-text, none cliloc-paged, so this is additive and not a duplicate. Both reader gumps were rewritten from ServUO's Gump API onto DynamicGumpBuilder - a real rewrite, and UNVERIFIED without a client. D-S5-4: ChronicleOfTheGargoyleQueen1.Initialize() became a static initializer; the values are constants so behaviour is identical.

ported_content.name: SAAbsorptionAttributes + DamageEaterContext
ported_content.note: Subsystem, not content. Additive against BaseAttributes, which ModernUO already ships. The property reaches items through an additive IAbsorptionItem interface rather than fields on BaseArmor/BaseWeapon/BaseJewel/BaseClothing, so no upstream serialization version is bumped - S1's decision, reused. BaseSetArmor is the only carrier today, at serialization field 11. The effect reaches combat through AOS-damage-eater-hook.patch, 16 added lines in Projects/UOContent/Misc/AOS.cs at ServUO's own call site. Pinned by six tests in ShatteredLegacy.Tests.AbsorptionAttributesVerification, of which ColdDamageThroughAosDamageReachesTheEater was proved to fail with the patch skipped.

ported_content.name: Gargoyle wearables, row share (9 files, 11 types)
ported_content.note: GargishGlasses, GargishPlateChest, GargishPlateLegs, GargishEarrings, GargishNecklace (+GargishAmulet, GargishStoneAmulet), GargishGnarledStaff, GargishKatana, GargishDagger, LargeStoneShield. ServUO's 'Race RequiredRace => Race.Gargoyle' is ModernUO's 'int RequiredRaces => Race.AllowGargoylesOnly' on armour/weapons/shields (Item.cs:2110); CanBeWornByGargoyles has zero readers and is dropped. S9's other three gargoyle files in this row (GargishClothArmor.cs, GargishLeatherArms, GargishStoneChest) were NOT ported: ModernUO already ships them as Gargish<Material><Slot>Type1/Type2 with the same item IDs, found by an item-ID cross-check, not by name.

ported_content.name: Greymist (Acolyte) armour set (4 files)
ported_content.note: ServUO derives these from stock Leather* and reads set state off BaseArmor; here they derive from S1's BaseSetArmor and reproduce the stock parent's members, the TigerPelt/Aloron shape. This is the transformation every one of the row's 83 set-armour files needs and S9's name scan could not see. Set bonus firing is NOT verified headlessly; batched for the client spot check.

ported_content.name: BaseCostume
ported_content.note: Shield-slot mask that body-mods the wearer; carrier for the 34 costumes in the in-row bucket, all now plain ports. Two persisted ints (CostumeBody, CostumeHue) at version 0; ServUO's three save versions collapse. Deviation D-5: ServUO knocks the costume off from AOS.Damage (AOS.cs:417); ModernUO has no call site, so a masked player keeps the mask through combat. One line added to the existing AOS-damage-eater-hook.patch would restore it.

ported_content.name: CC9 batch 2: 33 costumes + 7 unblocked artifacts (40 files, 41 types)
ported_content.note: The 33 costumes are one template on BaseCostume (body, one hue, creature name, cliloc or default name) and were generated from the ServUO values by a script that refuses any file whose constructor or overrides differ from the template; it refused none. CastOffZombieSkin, CuffsOfTheArchmage (2 types), PillarOfStrength, BreastplateOfTheBerserker, GiantSteps, Glasses, NightEyes hand-written; three of them derive from ModernUO's own Gargish*Type1/Type2 classes rather than a ported parent. Green first cycle (95 s), 41/41 reflected, headless save/reload clean. Reading the 19 in-row artifacts batch 1 supposedly unblocked found 6 more absorption users and 5 set pieces on gargish jewellery, so only 8 were plain - S9's in-row bucket checked one member per file.

ported_content.name: CC9 batch 1: artifacts and equipment (31 files, 34 types)
ported_content.note: 2,604 ServUO lines in, 1,324 out. Category-spread sample chosen to test S9's 'drops straight in' claim: 20 of 34 types needed only the standard conversion, 8 would not have compiled mechanically (four set pieces re-parented, fishing-pole attributes, BattleLust, two non-virtual overrides on earrings/necklace, IRepairable), 3 must not be ported at all (already in ModernUO). Real persisted state exercised on GobletOfCelebration (SerializableProperty + DeltaDateTime + AfterDeserialization timer rebuild), AmuletOfRighteousness (IUsesRemaining) and BaseCostume. Deviations D-3 AxeOfAbandon BattleLust, D-4 XenrrFishingPole SpellChanneling/CastSpeed (ModernUO's FishingPole has no attribute block and AosAttributes.GetValue aggregates only the seven equipment bases), D-5 costume damage hook. Gated build 86 s; 33/33 types reflected; headless save and reload clean.

ported_content.name: The carrier family: BaseSetWeapon, BaseSetJewel, BaseSetClothing, BaseSetQuiver, BaseSetShield (5 files)
ported_content.source: ServUO set regions of Items/Equipment/{Weapons/BaseWeapon,Jewelry/BaseJewel,Clothing/BaseClothing,Quivers/BaseQuiver}.cs and BaseArmor via BaseShield
ported_content.note: Subsystem, not content: the set state ServUO puts on each base class, on an additive intermediate class of ours instead (the S1 decision, applied four more times). 1,426 lines, zero patches, zero migrations, 15 tests, every gate watched fail. Field layout identical to BaseSetArmor on every carrier (0-9, then SetSelfRepair 10 and absorption 11 where the ServUO base has them; jewel has absorption at 10; quiver has neither). SetSelfRepair inert on weapon/clothing/shield (Q-038). The four ported gargish armour-class bases were re-parented onto BaseSetArmor in the same commit, before any instance reached a save. Unblocks CC9 batch 4 (13 set pieces + 9 non-armour absorption users + 5 gargish-jewellery set pieces) and CC4's ReforgedSuffix route C.

ported_content.name: CC9 batch 3: the plain remainder (49 files, 49 types)
ported_content.note: 21 weapons, 11 jewellery, 17 armour and shields; 4,636 ServUO lines in, 1,740 out. Pre-flighted with the section-3 method before any build: every override checked against a pinned ModernUO virtual, every attribute member against the Aos* enums, item IDs cross-checked, and every ServUO descendant of all 49 walked transitively for set or absorption state. Nine bases got a carrier parent at port time because a descendant needs it (GargishPlateArms, GargishPlateKilt, the five DragonTurtleHide pieces on BaseSetArmor; GargishKiteShield on BaseSetShield; GargishBattleAxe on BaseSetWeapon, the ninth, found because GargishPincer assigns SetSkillBonuses, a token the AGENTS.md grep does not list - Q-040). The other 40 are on stock bases per docs/tasks.md. RandomWand is a static helper, not an item. Every override value re-diffed mechanically against ServUO after writing: 524 compared, 0 mismatches. Deviations D-10 (GargishWarHammer flip typo 0x481 -> 0x48C1), D-11 (EvilOrcHelm's two zero-reader virtuals), D-12 (OrcishBow one durability line, not two), D-13 (StaffRing IsPlayer; not OSI content). Gated build green first cycle, 101 s, 42 tests; 49/49 reflected; headless fresh save and reload clean.

ported_content.name: CC9 batch 4: the one re-parent, the 41 carrier-blocked, the set-armour bucket (125 files, 127 types; 3 edited)
ported_content.note: GargishDagger moved from BaseKnife to BaseSetWeapon (Q-040: StoneDragonsTooth needs AbsorptionAttributes), after re-verifying no instance in any save by reading the type tables of the live save (2026-07-06, 1,468 types, no Gargish* at all), the three Backups snapshots and the newest daily and hourly Archives (decompressed), not by date alone. The 41 carrier-blocked: 40 ported, Swiftflight declined (Bow sits on BaseRanged, no carrier can sit above it; Q-041). Two talismans ported on stock BaseTalisman with the eater dropped, which is behaviour-identical: ServUO never aggregates a talisman's absorption (RunicReforging.GetSAAbsorptionAttributes). The set-armour bucket counts 85, not 79: 79 set pieces plus the 6 Phoenix suit files that sit under Sets/ with no SetID and stay on stock parents. All 85 generated from ServUO values plus a dump of the pinned stock parent's members ([Flippable] copied because ModernUO reads it inherit:false; IArcaneEquip dropped on 6 gloves per D-7). Two corrections found by reading the parents: batch 3's GargishBattleAxe had lost BaseAxe (Slash1H, sword sounds, no harvesting) and S10's BaseSetWeapon skipped BaseMeleeWeapon's AbsorbDamage; both fixed, both save-neutral today. Bestial pieces ported with the berserk helper inert (its AOS.Damage/heal hooks do not exist here; Q-042). Deviations D-14..D-19. Value diff over 126 files: 0 findings, proved red with three injected faults. One failed build cycle (28 s, one inlined member), then green in 99 s with 42 tests; 130/130 reflected; headless fresh save and reload clean. 10,062 ServUO lines in, 6,363 out. See notes/cc9-artifacts.md section 14.

ported_content.name: CC4 Despise: the Revamped Despise dungeon (12 ServUO files + XmlSpawner XML -> 14 files, 4,684 lines)
ported_content.source: ServUO Services/Revamped Dungeons/DespiseRevamped/{AI,DespiseController,Region,Setup}.cs, Mobiles/Normal/Despise{Creature,GoodCreatures,EvilCreatures}.cs, Mobiles/Bosses/DespiseBosses.cs, Items/Quest/{WispOrb,PutridHeart}.cs, Items/Functional/DespiseAnkh.cs, Items/Internal/DespiseTeleporter.cs, Misc/WeakEntityCollection.cs, RevampedSpawns/DespiseRevamped.xml
ported_content.dest: server/customizations/Services/Revamped Dungeons/DespiseRevamped/, Mobiles/Normal/, Mobiles/Bosses/, Items/Quest/, Items/Functional/, Items/Internal/, Misc/; server/tests/Services/Revamped Dungeons/DespiseRevamped/; server/patches/BaseCreature-PlayerMobile-can-auto-stable.patch
ported_content.note: Regions are ServUO dynamic BaseRegions re-created by the controller; ModernUO's Region maps member for member except CheckTravel (now on BaseRegion with an out message), the absent EventSink.OnEnterRegion (DespiseRegion.OnExit instead), and priority: every pinned region is Dynamic so the tie with regions.json's Despise dungeon went to list order - priority 51. XmlSpawner XML became a 47-row table plus DespiseSpawner (PowerMin/PowerMax) applied in OnAfterSpawn, because ModernUO entries take fixed parameters. Headless on the real map: 227 creatures generated in bounds (capacity 227 of 229 requested: two XML rows exceed their entries), power 1-5 upper / 4-8 lower, 15+15 army spawners found, save/reload identical. 48 tests green, auto-stable gate proved red. Deviations (note-local D-29..D-36 in notes/cc4-despise.md): PutridHeart inert, MysteriousWisp not placed, Town Cryer hooks dropped, Silenii/Phantom Discordance dropped, ForceNotoriety absent, Container orb hook absent, lower level 4-8 vs a broken 2-arg XML, FightMode.Good/Evil -> Closest (behaviour-identical on pub57).

ported_content.name: CC6 batch 1: twenty creatures the stock spawn data places and could not spawn (20 files + GoblinOppositionGroup, 1 test)

declined_content.name: S3 costed menu - declines upheld with their ratios recorded
declined_content.reason: Measured 2026-09-07, notes/s3-decline-costs.md. Skill Masteries (45 files/8,542 lines, unblocks 14, patches 35 upstream files - fails the layering test). Vice vs Virtue (57/9,613, unblocks 5, patches 21). Exploring the Deep (70/10,292, unblocks 2 - structurally the safest build here and the worst ratio). Shadowguard (14/11,222, unblocks 8). City Loyalty (28/8,177, unblocks 15 - decline on ratio, not structure; revisit with Town Cryer). Instanced Peerless (13/1,543, unblocks 2, and BasePeerless and PeerlessAltar are both absent from ModernUO, so there is no base to instance - cost Services/Peerless first). ServUO's ML quest framework (22 files/6,269 lines, not the 21/5,625 the brief stated) - declined because ModernUO already ships the same OSI system. NOT declined and recommended instead: SAAbsorptionAttributes, the TribeType transformation, and a one-quest spike onto ModernUO's ML quest engine. Vendor Searching (4/2,545) is a player feature, not content; the unblock ratio is the wrong test and it is Chase's call.

declined_content.name: ServUO ML quest framework - decline REAFFIRMED by S5
declined_content.reason: S5 translated one quest end to end and the objective mapping holds for 4 of 5 types, two of them pinned by tests. Porting ServUO's 22-file, 6,269-line framework would put a second engine in the tree to do a job the engine we already have does correctly. The decline was always on two-engines-for-one-job; it now rests on measurement rather than on principle alone. What is NOT declined: the 164 of 203 missing quests that use a single standard objective type. The 39 that hand-write a BaseObjective subclass (25 InternalObjective, 3 CollectionsObtain, 2 QuestionAndAnswer, ~9 one-offs) are per-quest work, not a framework port, and are the thing to cost before the next quest batch.
